words.example: The display board in the lobby shows which number is being called.
words.exampleZh: 大厅的显示屏上能看到正在呼叫的号码。

words.example: The wayfinding toward the file room still confuses many visitors.
words.exampleZh: 通往档案室的导引标识仍然让很多访客搞不清方向。

words.example: The directory board next to the lift lists every ward and clinic.
words.exampleZh: 电梯旁边的楼层索引列出了每个病区和门诊。

words.example: A floor plan for this wing is posted right beside the stairs.
words.exampleZh: 这栋楼翼的平面图就贴在楼梯旁边。

words.example: The room number printed on her badge does not match her seat.
words.exampleZh: 她工牌上印的房间号和她的座位对不上。

words.example: The snapshot chain on the HIS VM is six levels deep and slowing every write.
words.exampleZh: HIS 虚拟机的快照链已经六层，每次写入都变慢。

words.example: The delta disk from last week's snapshot is larger than the base disk now.
words.exampleZh: 上周快照留下的增量盘，现在比基础盘还大。

words.example: A linked clone of the training VM shares the base disk and only stores changes.
words.exampleZh: 培训虚拟机的链接克隆和基础盘共用空间，只另外存变更。

words.example: A full clone of the HIS VM copies every block and can move to another datastore.
words.exampleZh: HIS 虚拟机的完整克隆会复制每一个块，也能迁到别的数据存储。

words.example: Deploy each clinic desktop from the template VM so every desk starts from the same build.
words.exampleZh: 每台门诊桌面都从虚拟机模板部署，每个工位的起点才是同一套构建。
